metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects ATT&CK technique T1218.011 (Rundll32). Adversaries may abuse rundll32.exe to proxy execution of malicious code. Using rundll32.exe, vice executing directly (i.e. [Shared Modules](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1129)), may avoid trigg
properties.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "mitre" or CommandLine contains "t1218" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 5 // AZ-MITRE-ATTACK-034
